KITTY KIBBLE - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-kittykibble.txt.

A hungry kitten eats every kibble of a room while four robot vacuums try to
tidy it up: Dash rushes straight at you, Sneak cuts you off, Patrol guards
its corner and Wobble wanders about. Grab a ball of yarn and the tables
turn: the scared vacuums can be caught for 20, 40, 80 and 160 points. Clean
the kitchen, the living room, the bedroom, the garden and the attic, each a
little faster. One catch and the run is over: medals at 200, 600, 1500 and
3000, and your best score is kept.

Run KittyKibble.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  steer the kitten          D-pad (a turn pressed      Arrows
                            early waits for the
                            next junction)
  start                     A (or Start, the D-pad)    X, Enter or an arrow
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a run) Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A (or Select) on the results
  touch / mouse             swipe to turn the kitten; a tap starts

Up to four kittens (ginger, silver, snow white and chocolate) race for the
kibble of the same house, each with their own pad and score: a kitten caught
is out, the others play on; the results rank everyone by score, with medals.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: KittyKibble.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in kittykibble.srm next to the exe.
